topic: Analytics view changes and testing plan
summary_markdown:
The team confirmed that recent changes to the `va` views, specifically regarding `facility_traffic_share`, did not affect data integrity. This was verified by running an impression script, showing 1:1 consistency for both production and beta environments.

Discussion highlighted that while different views are used for beta and production, the current single database structure makes immediate testing on a dedicated beta environment difficult. It was noted that once the database is split, proper testing on the beta environment will be implemented.

A link to the staging version of the analytics platform was shared, requiring review by someone regarding specific report changes before an anticipated deployment.
decisions: Changes to `va` views for `facility_traffic_share` are confirmed not to affect data.
action_items: Someone needs to review the report changes (made by 'Lesh') on the staging analytics version.
The team will proceed with deployment if all checks pass, followed by further testing.
